tasks.subject: Task 1: Rename package metadata in pyproject.toml
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace `analytify` metadata with `qualgraph`, add hatchling build system, fill metadata, add dev extras, remove analytify console script.

**Files:**
- Modify: `pyproject.toml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] name = "qualgraph"
- [ ] [build-system] with hatchling present
- [ ] All metadata fields filled
- [ ] dev extras include pytest, ruff, build, twine
- [ ] Only qualgraph console script
- [ ] pip install -e ".[dev]" succeeds
- [ ] pip check exits 0
- [ ] qualgraph --help exits 0

**Verify:** `pip install -e ".[dev]" && pip check && qualgraph --help`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["pyproject.toml"], "verifyCommand": "pip check && qualgraph --help", "acceptanceCriteria": ["name = qualgraph", "[build-system] with hatchling", "dev extras present", "pip check exits 0"]}
```

tasks.description:
